camera: Flat front-facing UI, no 3D previews or parallax.

hudLayout.topThird: Empty dark navy backdrop with a faint lighter radial glow; no header, counters or navigation. The top of the reward panel begins at ~27% from top.
hudLayout.middleThird: A khaki parchment reward panel ~75% of screen width, from ~27% to ~73% height, with a darker brown bottom lip and a small notch at bottom-right. Inside, top: title '4 HOUR TIME WARP' in cream bold caps centred at ~32%. Centre: a sky-blue chunky card frame (~46% of screen width, ~3:4 tall) with a silver inner bezel and a deep teal-blue inner field; in the middle sits a glossy painted octagonal bronze-amber clock/compass medallion with a single red hand pointing to 12, small gem studs around the rim (gold at top, red at left and right, dark at bottom). Below the card at ~67%: caption 'Moving time forward by 4 hours' in cream bold text.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Empty dark navy backdrop with no UI elements.

keyElements: sky-blue framed card with teal field
octagonal amber time-warp clock medallion icon
uiStyle: Flat khaki 9-slice panel with a darker lip; the card is a chunky sky-blue slab with a darker blue front face, a silver bevelled inner frame and a flat teal field; the clock is a glossy painted icon with a warm highlight.
colorPalette: Cold dark navy surround, a warm khaki block in the centre, a saturated sky/teal card and a bright amber icon as the hot focal point.
mood: A quiet, magical reward moment — time bending forward.
composition: Perfectly centred symmetric stack: title, card with icon, caption; the icon is the single focal point with large empty margins above and below.
